node.statement: Let p and q be stationary probability rows for such a G, with p_a>0 everywhere, and set c=min_a(q_a/p_a). Then 0<=c<=1, r=q-cp is nonnegative and stationary, and r has a zero coordinate. If c<1, then sum_a r_a=1-c>0, so node 1.3.1 says r is strictly positive, contradicting its zero coordinate. Hence c=1, and r=q-p is nonnegative with coordinate sum zero, so q=p.
